ports.name: clk_i
ports.function: provides global clock to module (module receives)

ports.name: rstn_i
ports.function: provides active-low reset to module (module receives)
ports.evidence: checked as async active-low reset (if rstn_i = '0') in processes

ports.name: bus_req_i
ports.function: carries bus request record into module (module receives)
ports.evidence: bus_req_i.stb and bus_req_i.rw used to gate bus accesses

ports.name: bus_req_i.addr
ports.function: supplies bus address for register/data selection (module receives)
ports.evidence: address bit used: if (bus_req_i.addr(2) = '0') then control

ports.name: bus_req_i.data
ports.function: carries bus write data into module (module receives)
ports.evidence: bus_req_i.data written into ctrl fields on write access

ports.name: bus_req_i.stb
ports.function: bus strobe input indicates valid transaction (module receives)
ports.evidence: if (bus_req_i.stb = '1') then bus access logic executes

ports.name: bus_req_i.rw
ports.evidence: if (bus_req_i.rw = '1') then write access else read

ports.name: bus_rsp_o
ports.function: drives bus response record out of module (module drives)

ports.name: bus_rsp_o.err
ports.function: drives bus error output, always '0' (module drives)

ports.name: bus_rsp_o.data
ports.function: drives bus response data outputs (module drives)
ports.evidence: bus_rsp_o.data assigned with ctrl, FIFO and rx/tx data on reads

ports.name: clkgen_en_o
ports.evidence: clkgen_en_o <= ctrl.enable; enables external clock generator

ports.name: clkgen_i
ports.function: provides clock vector selectable by prescaler (module receives)

ports.name: uart_txd_o
ports.function: drives UART serial TX line out (module drives)

ports.name: uart_rxd_i
ports.function: receives UART serial RX line into module (module receives)

ports.name: uart_rtsn_o
ports.evidence: uart_rtsn_o set based on ctrl.hwfc_en and rx_fifo.half

ports.name: irq_rx_o
ports.evidence: irq_rx_o <= ctrl.enable and (ctrl.irq_rx_* and rx_fifo status)

ports.name: irq_tx_o
ports.evidence: irq_tx_o <= ctrl.enable and ((ctrl.irq_tx_* and not tx_fifo.avail) or ...)

signals.name: uart_clk
signals.function: derived UART timing clock from clock generator
signals.evidence: uart_clk <= clkgen_i(to_integer(unsigned(ctrl.prsc)))

signals.name: ctrl
signals.function: control register bundle storing UART configuration bits
signals.evidence: ctrl fields assigned on bus writes in bus_access process

signals.name: ctrl.enable
signals.function: enable or disable UART operation
signals.evidence: assigned from bus write; used to gate tx/rx state bits and clears

signals.name: ctrl.sim_mode
signals.function: enable simulation-mode behaviors and logging
signals.evidence: assigned from bus write; used in tx_fifo.clear and sim-mode code

signals.name: ctrl.hwfc_en
signals.function: enable RTS/CTS hardware flow-control
signals.evidence: assigned from bus write; used in rtr_control and tx_engine CTS check

signals.name: ctrl.prsc
signals.function: prescaler selecting clkgen bit for uart_clk
signals.evidence: used in uart_clk <= clkgen_i(to_integer(unsigned(ctrl.prsc)))

signals.name: ctrl.baud
signals.function: baud divisor value for baud counters
signals.evidence: loaded from bus; used to set tx_engine.baudcnt and rx_engine.baudcnt

signals.name: ctrl.irq_rx_nempty
signals.function: enable RX-not-empty interrupt
signals.evidence: assigned from bus write; used in rx_irq_generator expression

signals.name: ctrl.irq_rx_half
signals.function: enable RX-half-full interrupt
signals.evidence: assigned from bus write; used in rx_irq_generator expression

signals.name: ctrl.irq_rx_full
signals.function: enable RX-full interrupt
signals.evidence: assigned from bus write; used in rx_irq_generator expression

signals.name: ctrl.irq_tx_empty
signals.function: enable TX-empty interrupt
signals.evidence: assigned from bus write; used in tx_irq_generator expression

signals.name: ctrl.irq_tx_nhalf
signals.function: enable TX-not-half-full interrupt
signals.evidence: assigned from bus write; used in tx_irq_generator expression

signals.name: ctrl.clr_rx
signals.function: one-cycle flag to clear RX FIFO
signals.evidence: assigned from bus write and auto-cleared each clock; used in rx_fifo.clear

signals.name: ctrl.clr_tx
signals.function: one-cycle flag to clear TX FIFO
signals.evidence: assigned from bus write and auto-cleared each clock; used in tx_fifo.clear

signals.name: tx_engine
signals.function: transmit engine registers and state bundle
signals.evidence: tx_engine fields assigned inside transmitter clocked process

signals.name: tx_engine.state
signals.function: transmit engine finite-state-machine state bits
signals.evidence: used in transmitter case statement and assigned each clock

signals.name: tx_engine.sreg
signals.function: shift register holding transmit data and start-bit
signals.evidence: initialized from tx_fifo.rdata & '0' and shifted each bit

signals.name: tx_engine.bitcnt
signals.function: transmit bit counter (bits remaining)
signals.evidence: set to constant then decremented via unsigned(tx_engine.bitcnt)-1

signals.name: tx_engine.baudcnt
signals.function: transmit baud timing counter
signals.evidence: compared to "0000000000" and reloaded from ctrl.baud

signals.name: tx_engine.done
signals.function: indicates transmission of one word done
signals.evidence: set to '1' when tx_engine.bitcnt = "0000" in transmitter

signals.name: tx_engine.busy
signals.function: indicates transmitter busy status
signals.evidence: tx_engine.busy <= '0' when state(1 downto 0) = "00" else '1'

signals.name: tx_engine.cts
signals.function: synchronizer for clear-to-send input
signals.evidence: tx_engine.cts <= tx_engine.cts(0) & uart_ctsn_i in transmitter process

signals.name: tx_engine.txd
signals.function: serial TX output bit register
signals.evidence: assigned in FSM to sreg(0) and default '1'; drives uart_txd_o

signals.name: rx_engine
signals.function: receive engine registers and state bundle
signals.evidence: rx_engine fields assigned inside receiver clocked process

signals.name: rx_engine.state
signals.function: receive engine finite-state-machine state bits
signals.evidence: used in receiver case statement and assigned each clock

signals.name: rx_engine.sreg
signals.function: shift register holding received bits
signals.evidence: rx_engine.sreg <= rx_engine.sync(2) & rx_engine.sreg(...), shifted on bit sample

signals.name: rx_engine.bitcnt
signals.function: receive bit counter (bits remaining)
signals.evidence: initialized then decremented via unsigned(rx_engine.bitcnt)-1 in receiver

signals.name: rx_engine.baudcnt
signals.function: receive baud timing counter
signals.evidence: compared to "0000000000" and loaded from ctrl.baud or half-delay

signals.name: rx_engine.done
signals.function: indicates reception of one word completed
signals.evidence: set to '1' when rx_engine.bitcnt = "0000"; used as rx_fifo.we

signals.name: rx_engine.sync
signals.function: three-stage synchronizer for serial RX input
signals.evidence: rx_engine.sync(2) <= uart_rxd_i; sync shifts on uart_clk = '1'

signals.name: rx_engine.over
signals.function: RX FIFO overrun flag (overflow detected)
signals.evidence: set when rx_fifo.we = '1' and rx_fifo.free = '0' in fifo_overrun process

signals.name: rx_fifo
signals.function: RX FIFO interface bundle to FIFO instance
signals.evidence: rx_fifo fields connected to neorv32_fifo port map (free, avail, rdata, half)

signals.name: rx_fifo.clear
signals.function: clear request to RX FIFO (synchronous)
signals.evidence: rx_fifo.clear <= '1' when ctrl.enable='0' or ctrl.sim_mode='1' or ctrl.clr_rx='1'

signals.name: rx_fifo.we
signals.function: write enable to RX FIFO when a byte received
signals.evidence: rx_fifo.we <= rx_engine.done; connected to fifo we_i port

signals.name: rx_fifo.re
signals.function: read enable to RX FIFO on bus read
signals.evidence: rx_fifo.re <= '1' when bus_req_i.stb='1' and bus_req_i.rw='0' and addr(2)='1'

signals.name: rx_fifo.wdata
signals.function: write data bus into RX FIFO from receiver
signals.evidence: rx_fifo.wdata <= rx_engine.sreg(7 downto 0) assigned concurrently

signals.name: rx_fifo.rdata
signals.function: read data bus output from RX FIFO
signals.evidence: bus_rsp_o.data(...) <= rx_fifo.rdata on data-register read

signals.name: rx_fifo.free
signals.function: indicates free entries available in RX FIFO
signals.evidence: free_o mapped from fifo instance; used to compute ctrl_rx_full and overrun

signals.name: rx_fifo.avail
signals.function: indicates data available in RX FIFO
signals.evidence: avail_o mapped from fifo instance; used in IRQ and bus reads

signals.name: rx_fifo.half
signals.function: indicates RX FIFO at least half-full
signals.evidence: half_o mapped from fifo instance; used in IRQ and rtr_control

signals.name: tx_fifo
signals.function: TX FIFO interface record grouping control, data and status signals
signals.evidence: Connected to FIFO instance ports in tx_engine_fifo_inst port map

signals.name: tx_fifo.clear
signals.function: FIFO synchronous clear; asserted when disabled, in sim, or on clear request
signals.evidence: tx_fifo.clear <= '1' when ctrl.enable='0' or ctrl.sim_mode='1' or ctrl.clr_tx='1'

signals.name: tx_fifo.we
signals.function: FIFO write-enable for TX (bus write to data register)
signals.evidence: tx_fifo.we <= '1' when bus_req_i.stb='1' and bus_req_i.rw='1' and addr(2)='1'

signals.name: tx_fifo.re
signals.function: FIFO read-enable for TX (asserted when transmitter idle)
signals.evidence: tx_fifo.re <= '1' when (tx_engine.state = "100") else '0'

signals.name: tx_fifo.wdata
signals.function: Write data bus (lower byte) for TX FIFO
signals.evidence: tx_fifo.wdata <= bus_req_i.data(data_rtx_msb_c downto data_rtx_lsb_c)

signals.name: tx_fifo.rdata
signals.function: Read data output from TX FIFO into transmitter shift register
signals.evidence: tx_engine.sreg <= tx_fifo.rdata & '0' loads FIFO data into transmitter

signals.name: tx_fifo.free
signals.function: Indicates FIFO has free entries (not full)
signals.evidence: free_o => tx_fifo.free in FIFO instantiation; used in bus read mapping

signals.name: tx_fifo.avail
signals.function: Indicates data available in TX FIFO
signals.evidence: avail_o => tx_fifo.avail in FIFO instantiation; used for IRQ and bus responses

signals.name: tx_fifo.half
signals.function: Indicates TX FIFO at least half full
signals.evidence: half_o => tx_fifo.half in FIFO instantiation; used for IRQ and status reads
